name: mt5-pp-mcp
description: MetaTrader 5 account operations, trading stats, and safety-gated writes as MCP tools.
notes: Live tools require a Windows host with MetaTrader 5 and the MetaTrader5 Python package (py -3 -m pip install MetaTrader5). Mirror-backed tools (mt5_sql, mt5_stats_summary, mt5_backtest_*) work on any platform against a previously synced store. Broker credentials are never read by the MCP server; login happens via mt5-pp-cli connect login with --password-env.
